title: What is known about maltego.com's web presence?

r1.text: Maltego result of [To Website [Quick lookup]] on maltego.Domain maltego.com: maltego.Website www.maltego.com (fqdn="www.maltego.com", ports=[80])

steps.text: A Maltego 'To Website [Quick lookup]' transform on the domain maltego.com returned a Website entity with FQDN www.maltego.com on port 80.
Port 80 conventionally indicates an HTTP (unencrypted) web service; the record itself does not state this.
maltego.com has a web presence at www.maltego.com, likely serving plain HTTP on port 80.

claims.text: maltego.com resolves to a website with FQDN www.maltego.com, listening on port 80.
The site appears to serve HTTP (unencrypted) traffic on port 80.
No other web properties (e.g., HTTPS on 443, additional subdomains) are evidenced in the available records.
